faq.q: What is the typical application for titanium lithography stage flexure?
faq.a: Titanium Lithography Stage Flexure is designed for monolithic flexure mount for lithography mirror stage. The Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V grade is selected to provide the optimal balance of strength, fatigue life, and environmental resistance for this specific application.

faq.q: How is titanium lithography stage flexure manufactured?

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium lithography stage flexure?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.
